intro.text: A young honorspren bonded to Lopen of Bridge Four, making him a Windrunner.

items.text: Rua began looking into Lopen as a possible bond partner after the Battle of Narak. Lopen swore the First Ideal before the Battle of Thaylen Field and the Second soon after, while talking with a wounded soldier.

Lopen nicknamed the spren Naco and played with him in the camps where the wounded were tended. When Lopen taught him a rude gesture, Rua used it on everyone, once growing extra arms to make it four times over at the Stormfather.
Rua sailed with Lopen to Akinah, showing himself to Rysn and helping Lopen track a sailor washed overboard. He kept watch on a shadow following the ship, which proved to be a Sleepless hordeling.

After Lopen was hurt fighting the hordelings guarding Akinah, Rua helped him swear his Third Ideal and became a Shardblade for the first time, engraved with a picture of Rua making his favourite rude gesture.

appearance.text: Appears as a ribbon of light, a boy of nine or ten, or a young man, and likes taking the form of a flying chull with broad wings.

personality.text: Mischievous and playful, fond of hide-and-seek, Rua does not seem able to speak, though Lopen understands his gestures. He worries about Lopen when things turn serious.
